1160 is a leap year (divisible by 4 and not a century exception in the Gregorian calendar rules).  
09-01-1160 is September 1, 1160.  
Subtract 57 days:  
Back 31 days → August 1, 1160.  
Remaining 26 days to subtract: July has 31 days, so July 6, 1160 (since 31 - 26 = 5 → July 6 is 26 days before August 1).
